svg.title: The South China Sea
svg.desc: Situation map covering 100.8°E to 125.0°E, 1.2°S to 25.5°N. A reference plate: the basin, the shelf, and the reefs — no claim line drawn. Natural Earth physical geography; no thematic layer. Maritime claims across this sea overlap and are disputed; none is drawn here. Natural Earth 1:50m physical and cultural vectors; GMTED2010-derived texture-shaded relief.
